name: E-Reader Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange e-reader with pink lens eyes in its bezel and "Chapter 6" on its e-ink screen, on a pink book
entry: It reads every book it can find, up to chapter six, and then forgets them all and starts again.
how: Use a E-Ink Screen on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Psyshock in this form.
